text:
Maria Chen: FYI PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8422 is stuck. It's a small SDK snippet + migration note but we don't have a reviewer assigned and linkcheck CI is flaky. can someone pick before EOD PST?

Kevin Liu: I can look but heads-up I'm in a deploy window until 3pm PT. if no-one claims, I can do a quick pass after that.

Olivia Park: I can grab the snippet review now (python + TS), but not the migration guide — need someone familiar with the platform changes.

Aj Patel: tagging the rotation: @docs-rotation — can the current rotation owner pick this up? also maybe mark as high-priority since it'll be referenced in the migration guide landing page.

Maria Chen: thanks @Olivia Park — can you at least approve the snippet so we can split the PR? I can carve out the migration guide into a follow-up if that helps.

Olivia Park: yep I can approve the snippet portion. pushing a small suggestion: change the example to use the new client initializer (per recent runtime change). I'll leave a comment. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: preview deployed for PR #8422 — staging link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/8422 (checks: build ok, linkcheck failing on /guides/migration#auth)

Samir Bhat: the linkcheck error is the old auth anchor; we moved anchors in the migration guide last week. quick fix is to add the new anchor or update the link. tagging @Kevin Liu if you want to handle the migration note commit.

Kevin Liu: OK I'll take the migration guide part after my window. ETA 4:30pm PT. if someone wants to merge the snippet earlier, that helps.

Maria Chen: procedure note: if snippet and migration text are logically separable, split into two commits and request quick-merge for the snippet. otherwise we block both. splitting is fine here.

Olivia Park: split done, pushed as separate commit. requesting reviewer: @Olivia Park (self-review done) and @Samir Bhat for final docs style check.

Samir Bhat: quick style pass — a couple nits but nothing blocking. +1 once I update a wording nit in the migration guide reference.

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck fixed on new commit, all checks green. Preview updated: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/8422/2

Aj Patel: since this touched SDK snippets, reminder to record which SDK versions the snippet is compatible with in the PR description. we had a coverage gap last month where snippets only matched go + ts and broke python examples.

Olivia Park: added "compatible: python>=0.9, ts>=1.2" to PR description.

Kevin Liu: migration guide updated and pushed. left a short note about the auth anchor change. can someone run the linkcheck again?

docs-bot: manual trigger: linkcheck job queued by Kevin Liu.

docs-bot: linkcheck job passed. all checks green.

Maria Chen: cool. who will merge? I can merge the snippet commit once Samir gives +1. Kevin can merge migration commit after 4:30pm PT (or I can do it if he needs).

Samir Bhat: +1 on snippet, merging now. :shipit:

Kevin Liu: migration guide merged at 16:36 PT. thanks everyone.

Maria Chen: awesome — this was a clean micro-handoff. logging for rotation notes: current gap was that rotation owner was OOO for the morning; suggestion: add an 'emergency pickup' tag to the rotation calendar so we get a pager with 2nd fallback.

Aj Patel: noted. i'll add a quick one-pager for "micro-handoffs" to the docs-onboarding folder so the next oncall knows how to split vs block.

Olivia Park: thanks all. saved me from doing both bits. :relieved:

Kevin Liu: nice teamwork. closing thread.
